name: Tic-tac-toe
description: Launch a tic-tac-toe board from the apps menu (or type /tic-tac-toe) and play it together in the channel - taps and the result are shared with everyone, since every move is one sandboxed frame. Press 'new game' to reset.
author: slim-m

permissions.name: Play tic-tac-toe
permissions.description: Launch and play a tic-tac-toe board in this space.

extension_points.name: play
extension_points.description: Play a move, or start a board.
